description: Generate a dashboard of complementary chart panels for a dataset — each panel answers a distinct analytical intent (trend, rank, distribution, correlation, etc.) and the engine diversifies by chart family by default. Heuristic only; no LLM call. Use when the user asks 'show me this data' or 'build me a dashboard' rather than picking one chart.

audience.description: Audience profile — familiarity, adoption targets, exposure level, and reception modality.

diversifyByFamily.description: Prefer not to repeat chart families across panels (default true).

fieldRoles.description: Per-field semantic or exact encoding-role hints used before chart ranking.

identifiers.description: Fields that identify records and must not be used as visual encodings or measures.

intents.description: Intents to cover. Omit to let the engine pick based on the data shape.

name: suggestDashboard
